title: Credential-store exceptions reach the HTTP failure body on add and rotate, so a submitted credential can leak
resolution: add and rotate catch every credential-store exception in AccountSlotService and answer fixed text, so a store error cannot carry a submitted credential into a response or log record.

title: Update validates allowedProjects before the slot and its revision, breaking the not-found then conflict order
resolution: update reads the slot read-only through readUpdatableSlot before the projects, so not-found, then revision conflict, then the state rule come before the 400 of an unknown project; the final transaction still compares and sets.

title: Credential-store unavailability on add and rotate answers 500 instead of the documented 503
resolution: PostgresSlotCredentials throws the port's typed SlotCredentialsUnavailable for an unavailable result; add and rotate map it to a fixed 503 and any other rejection to a fixed 500.

title: A sweep with failed slots returns ok and logs no sweep-failed record
resolution: logSlotCredentialSweep writes the sweep-failed warning with failed and swept slot counts when a sweep leaves failed slots, and the loop keeps running; a later clean sweep logs nothing.

title: Recorded branch coverage of the new account-slot-api.js is 74.00%, below the required 75% for changed files
resolution: Route tests cover store outages, bad identifiers and cursors, the minted identifier conflict, and the slot signals on the wire; a focused run shows 95 % of account-slot-api branches, the make verify number is still to be recorded.

title: The sweep scenario promises cleanup of any unnamed version, while a higher orphan version is deliberately retained
resolution: The sweep scenario now names a credential whose slot identifier has no record, and a new scenario says a higher orphan version waits for a later successful rotation or removal.

title: The cooldown requirement allows a default only when unset, while the implementation also defaults an empty value
resolution: The cooldown requirement says unset or empty is 60 minutes, and a new scenario covers the unset or empty value.

title: Design and proposal say four OpenAPI description changes, while the diff and the test hold five
resolution: design.md and proposal.md say five OpenAPI descriptions and the design's test sentence says five texts, keeping a pointer to the Deviations note on the brief's original four.
